# Jenel Studios

> Jenel Studios is a natural-light rental studio in downtown Dallas, Texas, bookable by the hour, half day, or full day at https://studio.taylormadecreative.net/. Rates are $60/hour on weekdays and $75/hour on weekends. It also runs hourly podcast sessions ($65/hour weekdays, $75/hour weekends) with the set, cameras, and mics provided. Booking is online with a live calendar and card payment, and confirmation is instant. It is a Taylormade Creative space (Instagram @jenelstudios).

Key facts (updated 2026-10-10):
- Location: downtown Dallas, TX. The exact address and access details are sent automatically with each booking confirmation.
- Rates: hourly $60 weekday / $75 weekend; half day (4 hours) $240 weekday / $300 weekend; full day (8 hours) $480 weekday / $600 weekend. Paid by card at booking, no deposit.
- The space: a 17 x 15 ft main room that flows into an open dining and kitchen area, with oversized windows, natural light, original hardwood floors, track lighting, and a full kitchen.
- Lighting add-ons, charged at checkout: Nova P300 $100, 300C $50, Amaran F22 $30, Spotlight $25, smoke machine $15.
- Room rentals don't include cameras; renters bring their own camera gear.
- Podcast sessions: $65/hour weekdays, $75/hour weekends, booked by the hour on the same live calendar. The set, cameras, and mics are provided and the studio runs the recording. Raw files are included: clients bring a drive or download them from Dropbox.
- Podcast edit add-on: $100 per episode for one full edited episode with the client's logo and branding, 3–4 day turnaround. Clients getting the edit need their logo and branding with them at the shoot.
- Your booked block covers load-in through load-out; reset the room the way you found it.
- Good for: photoshoots, content days, podcasts, digitals, product shots, workshops, yoga and movement classes, and small intimate events.
- Recurring or multi-day bookings: message @jenelstudios on Instagram or send an inquiry through Taylormade Creative.
- jenelstudios.com redirects to studio.taylormadecreative.net.
